target_boundary.full_gt6_source: All source-backed canonical identities in the frozen denominator unless explicitly marked out_of_scope.
target_boundary.denominator_provenance: The denominator classifications are a historical frozen baseline, not current implementation status.
target_boundary.cc_extension: CrucibleCraft additions are reported separately and never counted as GT6 source coverage.
target_boundary.out_of_scope: Explicit source policy exclusions remain visible and are not silently counted as missing.
target_boundary.player_path: Survival obtainability is an independent axis and never implied by runtime_ready.
target_boundary.freshness: Every derived row carries the frozen source revision and current working-tree evidence class.

unit_policy.rule: Rows, families, hosts, fluids, identities, and forms are independent units and must not be summed.
unit_policy.published_rows: Counts current source-addressable recipe JSON entries; not equivalent to GT6 dump rows.
unit_policy.overflow_rows: Counts selected-wave unresolved rows only; not a global GT6 remainder.
unit_policy.source_rows: Counts the frozen GT6 recipe-map denominator.
